g.title: Close-up. A street by day. Bob, centre, bored. Caption: 9:14.
Long shot. A street by day. Alice, centre, hands on hips; Bob, centre, arms crossed, looking at Alice. Caption: Outside the cinema. Bob: The film started at nine.
Close-up. A street by day. Alice, centre, scared. Alice, whispering: Oops.
Medium shot. A street by day. Alice, left, hands on hips; Bob, right, arms crossed, looking at Alice. Alice: I brought popcorn?
Full shot. A street by day. Alice, centre, hands on hips; Bob, centre, arms crossed, laughing, looking at Alice. Bob: Then we watch the next one.
